feeds.sql: SELECT l.LINE_CODE AS ID, l.LINE_NAME AS LABEL, NVL(p.ACTUAL_QTY, 0) AS VALUE, NVL(l.DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) AS TARGET, 'EA' AS UNIT FROM IP_PRODUCT_LINE l LEFT JOIN (SELECT LINE_CODE, SUM(ACTUAL_QTY) AS ACTUAL_QTY FROM IP_PRODUCT_SMD_PLAN WHERE PLAN_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 14 GROUP BY LINE_CODE) p ON p.LINE_CODE = l.LINE_CODE WHERE l.MES_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND l.LINE_PRODUCT_DIVISION = 'SMD' ORDER BY l.MES_DISPLAY_SEQUENCE

SELECT M.MACHINE_CODE AS ID, M.MACHINE_NAME AS LABEL, M.MACHINE_NAME AS NAME, T.ROOM_TEMPERATURE AS TEMPERATURE, T.HUMIDITY AS HUMIDITY, '{"min":' || NVL(M.MIN_TEMP_VALUE, 18) || ',"max":' || NVL(M.MAX_TEMP_VALUE, 28) || '}' AS TEMPERATURE_RANGE, '{"min":' || NVL(M.MIN_HUMIDITY_VALUE, 30) || ',"max":' || NVL(M.MAX_HUMIDITY_VALUE, 60) || '}' AS HUMIDITY_RANGE, 'SOLMAX / ENVIRONMENT MONITORING' AS TITLE FROM IMCN_MACHINE M, ICOM_TEMPERATURE_DATA T WHERE M.MACHINE_CODE = UPPER(T.NODEID(+)) AND M.ORGANIZATION_ID = T.ORGANIZATION_ID(+) AND M.MACHINE_TYPE = 'TEMP' AND M.MES_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND T.NODETYPE = 1 ORDER BY M.MES_DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, M.MACHINE_CODE

SELECT 'SG-' || LPAD(G, 2, '0') AS ID, LISTAGG(V, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY RN) AS VALUES_LIST, 'EOL TURN 2 / SM-EOL' AS NAME, 'mA' AS UNIT, 200 AS NOMINAL, 190 AS LSL, 215 AS USL, 1.33 AS CPK_TARGET FROM (SELECT CEIL(RN / 5) AS G, RN, V FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY LOG_TIMESTAMP DESC) AS RN, TO_NUMBER(MEAS_2) AS V FROM LOG_EOL WHERE NAME = 'TURN 2' AND MIN_2 = '190' AND REGEXP_LIKE(MEAS_2, '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')) WHERE RN <= 125) GROUP BY G ORDER BY G

WITH ACTIVE AS (SELECT WORKSTAGE_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_DEFICIT = 'I' THEN IO_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS IN_QTY, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_DEFICIT = 'O' THEN IO_QTY ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_QTY FROM IP_PRODUCT_WORKSTAGE_IO WHERE ENTER_DATE >= SYSDATE - 1 GROUP BY WORKSTAGE_CODE), S AS (SELECT W.WORKSTAGE_CODE, W.WORKSTAGE_NAME, W.WORKSTAGE_SORT_ORDER, NVL(W.ST_VALUE, 0) AS ST_VALUE, NVL(W.UPH_VALUE, 0) AS UPH_VALUE, NVL(A.IN_QTY, 0) - NVL(A.OUT_QTY, 0) AS QUEUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY W.WORKSTAGE_SORT_ORDER, W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) AS RN, COUNT(*) OVER () AS N FROM IP_PRODUCT_WORKSTAGE W JOIN ACTIVE A ON A.WORKSTAGE_CODE = W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) SELECT WORKSTAGE_CODE AS ID, WORKSTAGE_NAME AS LABEL, WORKSTAGE_CODE AS CODE, ST_VALUE AS CYCLE_SECONDS, UPH_VALUE AS CAPACITY_PER_HOUR, GREATEST(QUEUE, 0) AS QUEUE, '{"x":' || ROUND(-430 + (RN - 1) * (860 / GREATEST(N - 1, 1))) || ',"y":' || CASE WHEN MOD(RN, 2) = 1 THEN 75 ELSE -90 END || ',"z":' || (MOD(RN, 3) * 40 - 40) || '}' AS POSITION, 'SOLMAX / WORKSTAGE FLOW' AS TITLE, 480 AS DEMAND_PER_HOUR FROM S ORDER BY RN

links.sql: WITH ACTIVE AS (SELECT DISTINCT WORKSTAGE_CODE FROM IP_PRODUCT_WORKSTAGE_IO WHERE ENTER_DATE >= SYSDATE - 1), S AS (SELECT W.WORKSTAGE_CODE, W.WORKSTAGE_NAME, LEAD(W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY W.WORKSTAGE_SORT_ORDER, W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) AS NEXT_CODE, LEAD(W.WORKSTAGE_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY W.WORKSTAGE_SORT_ORDER, W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) AS NEXT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY W.WORKSTAGE_SORT_ORDER, W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) AS RN FROM IP_PRODUCT_WORKSTAGE W JOIN ACTIVE A ON A.WORKSTAGE_CODE = W.WORKSTAGE_CODE) SELECT WORKSTAGE_CODE || '>' || NEXT_CODE AS ID, WORKSTAGE_NAME || ' -> ' || NEXT_NAME AS LABEL, WORKSTAGE_CODE AS FROM_CODE, NEXT_CODE AS TO_CODE, CASE WHEN MOD(RN, 2) = 1 THEN -70 ELSE 70 END AS BEND FROM S WHERE NEXT_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY RN

feeds.sql: SELECT M.MACHINE_CODE AS ID, M.MACHINE_NAME AS LABEL, TO_NUMBER(M.LINE_CODE) AS LINE_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY M.LINE_CODE ORDER BY M.WORKSTAGE_CODE, M.MACHINE_CODE) AS ORDER_NO, LOWER(M.MACHINE_TYPE) AS KIND, CASE WHEN NVL(M.MACHINE_STATUS_CODE, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'running' WHEN M.MACHINE_STATUS_CODE IN ('S','P','E','W','X','C') THEN 'idle' WHEN M.MACHINE_STATUS_CODE IN ('A','B') THEN 'alarm' ELSE 'maintenance' END AS STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT M.LINE_CODE) OVER () AS LINES FROM IMCN_MACHINE M WHERE M.MES_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND M.MACHINE_TYPE <> 'TEMP' AND REGEXP_LIKE(M.LINE_CODE, '^[0-9]+$') AND M.LINE_CODE <> '00' ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(M.LINE_CODE), ORDER_NO

WITH R AS (SELECT RUN_NO, MODEL_NAME, LINE_CODE, LOT_SIZE FROM (SELECT * FROM IP_PRODUCT_RUN_CARD WHERE RUN_STATUS IN ('2','3','4','5') ORDER BY RUN_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1), Q AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT SERIAL_NO, QC_SEQUENCE, BAD_REASON_CODE, MACHINE_CODE, QC_DATE FROM IP_PRODUCT_WORK_QC WHERE QC_DATE >= SYSDATE - 7 AND QC_RESULT IN ('N','O') ORDER BY QC_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 50) SELECT Q.SERIAL_NO || '-' || Q.QC_SEQUENCE AS ID, CASE Q.BAD_REASON_CODE WHEN 'A' THEN 'APPEARANCE' WHEN 'B' THEN 'FUNCTION' WHEN 'C' THEN 'SPEC' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS LABEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Q.QC_DATE) AS SERIAL, Q.MACHINE_CODE AS EQUIPMENT_ID, R.RUN_NO AS ORDER_ID, R.MODEL_NAME AS PRODUCT, R.LINE_CODE AS LINE, R.LOT_SIZE AS QUANTITY FROM R LEFT JOIN Q ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY Q.QC_DATE
